g.title: Entity Relationship Diagram created by erdantic

a.xlink:title:
lca_models.chemistry.chemistry_models.Equation
Pydantic model representing a stoichiometrically balanced chemical equation.
Holds the full reaction SMILES together with explicit lists of :class:`ReactionParticipant` objects for reactants and products.
Attributes: reaction_smiles: Reaction SMILES string (format: ``"reactants>agents>products"``). reactants: Left-hand side participants with stoichiometric coefficients. products: Right-hand side participants with stoichiometric coefficients.

lca_models.chemistry.chemistry_models.ReactionParticipant
A molecule together with its stoichiometric coefficient in a reaction.
Separating stoichiometry from identity means a :class:`Molecule` can be reused across many reactions without carrying context-specific coefficients.
Attributes: molecule: The chemical species. stoichiometry: Integer coefficient (defaults to 1).

lca_models.chemistry.chemistry_models.Molecule
Pydantic model representing a chemical species (identity only, no stoichiometry).
Stoichiometric coefficients belong on :class:`ReactionParticipant`, not here.
Attributes: smiles: SMILES string uniquely identifying the molecule's structure. name: Optional human-readable name (e.g. ``"ethanol"``). chemical_formula: Optional molecular formula (e.g. ``"C2H6O"``).

lca_models.chemistry.chemistry_models.QuantityDescriptor
A qualified numeric descriptor with a physical unit.

lca_models.chemistry.chemistry_models.SMILESDescriptor
Canonical or as-given SMILES string for a molecule.

lca_models.chemistry.synthesis_models.ReactionNode
A single step in a synthesis route (flat, non-recursive).
Attributes: node_id: Content-hash ID derived from ``reaction_SMILES``. Filled by the linker — leave empty. reaction_SMILES: Reaction SMILES (format: ``reactants>agents>products``). target_molecule: Main product of this step. byproducts: By-product molecules. detailed_equation: Optional stoichiometrically balanced equation. process_description: Optional industrial process description. precursor_node_ids: IDs of upstream reaction nodes. Filled by the linker — leave empty.

lca_models.chemistry.synthesis_models.SynthesisRoute
Flat list of reaction steps representing a complete synthesis route.
The LLM populates ``nodes`` with one :class:`ReactionNode` per reaction step. ``root_node_id`` is derived by ``link_reaction_nodes()`` and must be left empty in LLM output.
Attributes: root_node_id: ``node_id`` of the final target-product step. Filled by the linker — leave empty. nodes: All reaction steps, in any order.
